The markdown (page-161.md lines 28-30) ends the table row at 'boolean exclusive |' and puts 'disjunction)' on its own line directly after it, before the unary table. The claim quotes both sources correctly. Still, the word is present on the adjacent line, in order, and nothing is lost or changed. The defect is a line-wrap and table-formatting artifact of the transcription. It does not change what B-XOR means or any normative content, and the verification rules reject a difference that is only line wrapping or formatting.
